native_result.query: How does the consideration of academic characteristics alter the effects of Socioeconomic Status and race on BA degree completion?
native_result.HypoA: When academic characteristics are considered, the effect of SES on BA degree completion is reduced and the effect of race is enlarged.
native_result.HypoB: 将学术特征（ASVAB 认知成绩复合分与高中班级排名百分位，均于 1981 年早于绝大多数人的大学阶段测得）纳入后，SES 与族裔对大学轨道参与（Bachelor-track，代理结果）的效应被大幅削弱：1981-1984 宿舍/兄弟会/姐妹会居住界定的四年制大学轨道上，Black 相对 Non-Black Non-Hispanic 的劣势系数衰减约 70%-107%（由边缘显著转不显著）；家庭 SES（1979 家庭收入+父母最高学历标准化复合）每 SD 优势系数衰减约 37%-44%（OR 由 1.9-2.5 降至 1.5-1.7 且仍显著）；1981-1986 加宽窗口一致（Black 衰减 55%-92%，SES 40%-46%）。即 SES/种族效应的较大部分与早期学业准备的差异相伴随（描述性中介），SES 仍有独立残差；Hispanic 条件效应为正且增强（抑制效应）。四项限定：结果代理性（61 列无 1979 后学历字段，grade>=16 仅 39 例，不得外推为完成度）；缺失与纵向流失（完整病例 56.7%，留存者能力更高）；学业中介时序（ASVAB 亦受早期家庭环境影响，故为描述性/关联性）；SES 操作化（1979 收入+父母教育为主，净财富与储蓄仅敏感性）。
native_result.WorkflowB: Nested logistic regression (same complete-case samples): Model1 = outcome~race(Black/Hispanic vs Non-Black Non-Hispanic)+SES(z-composite of log1979 income & max parental education)+controls(age,sex,family size,ever-jail residence); Model2 = Model1 + ASVAB composite z + class-rank percentile z. Reported % attenuation, OR change, mediation share, bootstrap(400) CI of (b_full-b_red). Sensitivities: window 1981-86; grade>=16 (descriptive only, n=39); +savings(1989 time-preference) & net wealth 1996; ever-jail exclusion; SES components separately; attrition profile. Interpreted as descriptive/associational mediation (academics measured 1981, before college for most).
